parameters.status: Measured total mass; estimated distribution, inertia, motor and contact dynamics
parameters.mass_notes: User-measured total robot mass, including battery and cushions: 2.754 kg. Non-cushion group masses were uniformly scaled from prior estimates; individual battery/chassis/leg masses and COM remain estimated.
limitations: Rigid bodies only; no PLA/PETG bending, fracture or layer anisotropy
Collision primitives approximate CAD; no exact concave mesh contacts
Joint axes and exported zero remain provisional
PD gains, delays, armature, friction, battery resistance, COM and motor curve are estimates
No thermal protection, firmware watchdog, exact firmware actuator limiter, gear backlash or battery discharge chemistry
Rated torque is reported as overload exposure, not enforced as a peak torque limit; long runs are not thermally validated

battery_pack.source: User confirmed 11.1V 3S; simulated source voltage is a reference operating point, not measured present voltage

mass_measurement.distribution: Estimated: non-cushion groups scaled uniformly; not individually measured

feedback: Only delayed/quantized Euler + separately delayed body gyro; contact forces/truth are evaluation only
